title: Hadwiger Conjecture (Covering)
exact_target: Can every n-dimensional convex body be covered by at most 2 to the n translated, positively contracted copies of itself?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1378 (GEOM-019). CC BY 4.0.
Yegor Gorodzha, \emph{Fractional illumination and the optimal exponential rate in Hadwiger's covering conjecture} (2026), arXiv:2609.23913v1, Section 1, first paragraph.
